title: Oklahoma Minimum Wage Act
source_id: Okla. Stat. tit. 40, secs. 197.1 et seq.
verified_how: fetched the register's official titles index https://www.oklegislature.gov/OSSTATUESTITLE.HTML: 'Title 40 - Labor' listed, and the page states 'The Oklahoma Constitution and Oklahoma Statutes were last updated on November 18th, 2025.' Then queried the Legislature's own statute search (https://search.oklegislature.gov/query-statutes.php?Title=Title+40+-+Labor&SearchText=Oklahoma+Minimum+Wage+Act): 4 current sections carry the short title - 40-197.2, 40-197.5, 40-197.15 and 40-197.16 - and a broader Title 40 search for 'minimum wage' returned 31 current sections running through the 197-series. The url given is the register's own canonical location for Title 40; it is a complete-title PDF of statute text and was not downloaded.
notes: SECTION-LEVEL DETAIL NOT READ: the register serves no HTML table of contents and OSCN was unreachable, so section catchlines and the exact closing section of the Act were not verified. The separate wage-payment provisions in Title 40 could not be confirmed: a Title 40 search for the phrase 'Protection of Wages' and for 'designated paydays' each returned 0 results, so the commonly cited 'Protection of Wages Act' label for 40 O.S. secs. 165.1 et seq. is NOT asserted here and a human should check it.
